relationships.subject: CGRP8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: We show that inhibiting CGRP-R activity with the antagonist CGRP 8-37, in the right CeA attenuates bladder pain-like behavior

relationships.subject: cyclophosphamide
relationships.evidence_quote: As hypothesized, in CYP animals, we observed an increase in the firing frequency of CGRP-R+ cells in the right CeA compared to the left CeA.

relationships.subject: right central amygdala CGRP-R+ neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: These data further confirm the pronociceptive function of CGRP-R in bladder pain in the right CeA.

key_findings: CGRP8-37 in the right but not left CeA attenuated cyclophosphamide-induced persistent bladder pain.
CGRP-R+ CeA neurons in the right hemisphere showed increased firing and calcium activity after CYP.
